title: Writ against Clause 6.9 load-increase direction premature pending s.126(3) objection
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Sunil Ambwani, J.; Bharat Bhushan, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed as premature; s.126(3) objection then s.127 appeal
headnote: A writ challenging a Clause 6.9 direction to increase sanctioned load is premature while the consumer's Section 126(3) objection is still pending. After that objection is decided, the statutory remedy is an appeal under Section 127 of the Electricity Act, 2003.
facts: Smt. Kamla Sharma was directed on 9 August 2012 to increase her electricity load from 1 KVA to 2.1 KVA under Clause 6.9 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. She filed an objection under Section 126(3) of the Electricity Act, 2003, which remained pending. While that objection was still undecided she petitioned the Allahabad High Court by writ to challenge the load-increase direction. The State appeared through Standing Counsel.

holding_units.holding: A writ petition against a direction under Clause 6.9 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 to increase electricity load is premature while the consumer's objection under Section 126(3) of the Electricity Act, 2003 remains pending. Once that objection is decided, the consumer's remedy is an appeal under Section 127.

not_decided.point: Merits of the Clause 6.9 load-increase direction and of the pending Section 126(3) objection
